before_the_lighter.title: Before the Grand Lighter
before_the_lighter.//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 202): a Stenchmaster Channel documentary, on the portable set in the bunker. How the ancients got a light: the ceremonial Fire-Waft (very grand, very far away), the Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition (97 pages per cigar), and Cheapy's 'invention'. It plays from the top again whenever it finishes. Nothing in it is a real procedure.

beats.line: channel_narrator: Before the Grand Lighter, there was... nothing. Nothing dependable. Nothing at all.
channel_narrator: For a light, an Ancient Grand Stenchmaster performed the ceremonial Fire-Waft. Unreliable. Spectacular. Not recommended within a mile of anything you'd miss.
channel_narrator: Brogath the Bashful performed it only once. He was too shy to aim. They found the cigar in the next county. Unlit.
channel_narrator: And so: the Bureau of Ceremonial Ignition. Ninety-seven pages per cigar. Most applicants died of old age. Then of boredom. Then they came back, and finished the forms.
channel_narrator: Then came Cheapy. And the Grand Lighter. MECHANICAL ignition. It worked once, on television, and nobody has ever looked back. (It has never worked again.)
channel_narrator: Before the Grand Lighter. Coming up next: Before the Grand Lighter.
